text: जले हुए या बंद मीटर की शिकायत आती है तो मैं जाकर फ़ोटो खींचता हूँ, रीडिंग नोट करता हूँ, नया मीटर लगाता हूँ और जॉब कार्ड भरता हूँ।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: दस साल से गाँव में बिजली का छोटा-मोटा काम करता हूँ। फ्यूज़ बदलना, पंखे का कंडेंसर बदलना, नए कमरे की वायरिंग करना। कोई सर्टिफिकेट नहीं है, बस काम आता है।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I check my panel wiring point to point against the drawing before giving it to the QC team; if any wire has the wrong number I correct it.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I change single phase and three phase meters for the discom and seal them.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Four years in a panel shop in Ahmedabad. We make MCC and PLC panels for machine builders. I mount the components on the back plate, route the wires in PVC duct, and then check continuity of every point with a multimeter.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: मैंने अपने मामा से काम सीखा। पहले सिर्फ़ उनके साथ तार और पाइप उठाता था, अब खुद सॉकेट, होल्डर और बोर्ड बना लेता हूँ। अर्थिंग के लिए गड्ढा खोदकर उसमें कोयला-नमक डालने का काम भी मैं ही करता हूँ।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: ट्रांसफ़ॉर्मर का तेल चेक करना, सिलिका जेल बदलना, ब्रीदर साफ़ करना और शटडाउन में कनेक्शन टाइट करना — ये सब काम मैंने पावर हाउस में सीखा।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: construction site pe 2 saal electrician ke saath raha, temporary board banana, extension dena, phir flats ki pakki wiring. ab apne gaon me khud ka kaam hai
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: main 5 saal se ghar ki wiring karta hoon, pipe dalna, taar khichna, board fitting, MCB aur DB lagana sab aata hai
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: राइस मिल में आठ साल से काम कर रहा हूँ। बड़ी मोटरें, स्टार्टर पैनल, केबल और 200 KVA ट्रांसफ़ॉर्मर की देखभाल करता हूँ।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: mai chhat dekh ke batata hu kitne panel aayenge aur kitna material lagega, phir team ke saath lagwata hu aur last me customer ko samjhata hu kaise use kare
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I work in a food processing unit. When a conveyor motor won't start I check supply at the MCCB, then the contactor coil, the overload, and the winding with a multimeter. I also did the complete three phase wiring for our new boiler house with 4 core cable.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: meter jal gaya ya band hai to complaint pe jaate hai, check karke replace karte hai, job card bharte hai
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: solar panel fitting ka kaam karta hu chhat pe, structure lagana, panel kasna, DC wire inverter tak le jaana
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: मोटर ट्रिप होती है तो पहले तीनों फेज़ चेक करता हूँ, फिर कॉन्टैक्टर की कॉइल और ओवरलोड, फिर मल्टीमीटर और मेगर से वाइंडिंग। ये सब मैंने बड़े भाई के साथ शुगर फ़ैक्टरी में सीखा।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: 10 years with an electrical contractor on industrial projects: three phase distribution, installing LT panels, cable termination, pipe earthing, and IR and continuity testing before charging.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I have spent 8 years as the electrician in a textile mill in Bhiwandi. I maintain the three phase motors, change contactors and overload relays in the DOL and star-delta starters, and lay cables from the main panel to the looms.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Bhaiya ke saath kaam seekha, ab flat me concealed wiring karte hai. Main deewar kaat ke pipe daalta hu, wo main connection dete hai.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I do small off-grid systems in villages: two or three panels, a charge controller, one or two batteries and an inverter for lights and fans. I learnt this when a company came to our area under a government scheme.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I run and look after the 250 kVA DG set in our factory: daily diesel, coolant and battery check, log book, and changeover when the grid power goes. I also make pipe and plate earthing and check the earth resistance with the earth tester.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: मैंने ITI नहीं किया, फ़ैक्टरी में ही सीनियर से सीखा। पहले तार काटना और फेरूल प्रिंट करना, फिर धीरे-धीरे पूरा पैनल वायर करना।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: When a meter is reported burnt or stopped, I go and check it, take the photo and reading, replace it, and fill the job card for the office.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I crimp lugs, put ferrules and dress the wires in the panel neatly with cable ties.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: factory me electrician hu 6 saal se, motor starter contactor overload sab ka kaam. star delta wiring khud karta hu
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I do the wiring of PLC panels: input and output cards to terminal blocks, 24V DC supply, relays, and I mark every wire with the number from the drawing so the testing person can check it.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Making panels for 6 years, mostly feeder and control panels for a pump company and some PLC panels. All the inside wiring and terminal block work I do myself.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: शादी और मेले में टेंट वालों के लिए अस्थायी लाइट लगाता हूँ, बाकी दिनों में घरों की वायरिंग।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Our company builds panels for HVAC and pumps. I fix the components on the DIN rail, wire the contactors and timers, and route the wires in channels so it looks clean.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Mai panel me continuity check karta hu multimeter se, har point ko drawing ke saath tick karta hu
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: दुकानों और घरों में वायरिंग करता हूँ, घर का इन्वर्टर-बैटरी भी जोड़ देता हूँ। एक बार सोलर वाली कंपनी के साथ छत के पैनल से आने वाले तार DB तक लाने में हाथ बँटाया था। ज़्यादातर काम ठेकेदार के नीचे ही करता हूँ।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: मैं ठेकेदार के साथ फ़ैक्टरियों में थ्री फेज़ वायरिंग करता हूँ। आर्मर्ड केबल बिछाना, ट्रे लगाना, ग्लैंड और लग लगाकर पैनल में टर्मिनेशन करना, फिर मेगर से टेस्ट करना।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Learnt from my cousin who has a solar shop in Indore. I go with him to put panels on houses and schools, set the tilt angle, connect the batteries and inverter, and later go back for cleaning and service.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I have installed more than 3000 prepaid smart meters in Bihar in the last year. I know how to pair the meter with the communication unit and check the signal on the handheld device.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: mere chacha ki solar ki dukaan hai, unse seekha. battery, charge controller, inverter jodna aur load chalake test karna aata hai
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: For 5 years I have been doing house and shop wiring with my senior. Once we went to a rooftop where a company was putting solar plates and we ran the wire from their inverter down to the house DB. But my everyday work is wiring rooms, fitting boards, sockets and MCBs.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Three years with a solar dealer. I fit the mounting structure, place the panels, tighten the clamps, connect the panels in series, run DC cable to the inverter and do the earthing and lightning arrester.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: electrician ka helper hu, roz naye makaan me jaate hai. modular switch board, 6A 16A socket, LED light, door bell sab lagata hu. tester se phase check karta hu
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: मैं पिछले छह साल से घरों में वायरिंग का काम कर रहा हूँ। दीवार में पाइप डालना, तार खींचना, स्विच बोर्ड लगाना, पंखा और लाइट फिट करना सब करता हूँ। ठेकेदार के साथ काम करता हूँ, वो बताते हैं कहाँ क्या लगेगा।
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: off grid system lagaye hai gaon me, school aur dispensary me bhi. 150Ah battery, PWM controller, 1kva inverter
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Worked 3 years in Surat with a contractor doing shop and office wiring, both concealed and open. I can find phase and neutral with the tester. Our supervisor checks everything before we switch on the supply.

author: ai-synthetic-blind

author: ai-synthetic-blind

author: ai-synthetic-blind

author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I have been doing house wiring for about 4 years as a helper with a local electrician in Pune. I cut the chases in the wall, lay the PVC pipe, pull the wires and fit the switch boards. Mostly 1BHK and 2BHK flats.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I work under an electrician in offices and showrooms. We do the wiring and fix the distribution board. Sometimes the electricity board man comes to change the meter and I help him by showing the incoming cable and connecting our main switch after the meter.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Bhai mera kaam hai jab factory me koi machine band ho jaye to fault dhundna. Contactor gaya, overload trip, fuse udd gaya, ya cable me short. Multimeter, clamp meter, megger sab use karta hu.

author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I fix switches, sockets, tube lights and fans in houses and shops.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: We did 3 kW to 10 kW on-grid systems in housing societies. I work in a team of three. My part is mostly panel fixing, cable laying and connecting the inverter.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: I am a maintenance electrician in a factory. When the panel shop is busy I sometimes wire small control panels myself with ferrules and all, but mostly my job is motors, starters, cables, earthing, and running the generator when the power goes off.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: दुकानों और छोटी फ़ैक्टरियों में थ्री फेज़ मीटर लगाता हूँ, फेज़ का क्रम और न्यूट्रल ठीक से जोड़ता हूँ, फिर टर्मिनल कवर पर सील लगाता हूँ।

text: Sometimes when I go to change a meter the wiring after the meter is very bad, so I tell the consumer to call their own electrician. I only touch the service cable and the meter: I fit the meter box, install the smart meter, seal it and record the reading.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Six years helping in the wiring of new houses. I can make the earthing, do the doorbell, geyser point and AC point with 4 mm wire, and fit the main switch and MCBs when the electrician tells me.
author: ai-synthetic-blind

text: Ek steel plant me contractor ke under 4 saal, armoured cable laying, termination, gland, lugs, MCCB panel fitting
